purpose: Explicit lineage-bound MiMo first batch, full and same-input resume; offline replay does not contact a provider.
input_identity: Five explicit JSON manifests and lineage with SHA256; no baseline fallback.
allowed_variable: REAL_MIMO_CHAIN_UPSTREAM selects the bundle; REAL_MIMO_ONLINE=1 grants the existing online path. REAL_CHAIN_FINISH_HANDOFF publishes a ready manifest only after the MiMo report is business-complete. REAL_CHAIN_MIMO_REUSE_CALLS restores an exact public-prompt match and does not count it as a new attempt. Speaker resource variables are recorded, not inferred from gpu_used.
oracle: offline has zero provider calls; online remains partial and migration equivalence is not assessed
